title: A Fefferman--Stein inequality for the Dunkl Poisson semigroup and its chamber-lifted formulation
summary: We prove a Fefferman--Stein good-$λ$ inequality for the Dunkl Poisson semigroup associated with a finite reflection group and a non-negative multiplicity function. For arbitrary complex-valued $f\in C_c^\infty(\mathbb R^N)$, with no $G$-invariance assumption, it compares the orbit-conical non-tangential maximal function $\mathcal N_P^βf$ with the area function $\mathcal S_Pf$ formed from the full space-time Dunkl carré du champ, including its reflection-difference energy.
